sections.heading: Six game families. One unified engine

items.title: Chess
items.body: {{counts.chess_variants}} variants from Standard through to Duck Chess, Atomic, and Horde. Five AI difficulty tiers. Opening books.

items.title: Draughts
items.body: International, English, Brazilian, Russian, Turkish, and more. Forced captures, flying kings, configurable boards.

items.title: Go
items.body: Standard 9x9, 13x13, and 19x19 boards. Ko detection, territory scoring, handicap stones. Atari and Capture Go.

items.title: Shogi
items.body: Standard Shogi, Mini Shogi, Judkins Shogi, and Tori Shogi. Piece drops, promotion zones, impasse handling.

items.title: Xiangqi
items.body: Chinese Chess with palace and river constraints. Standard, Banqi (blind chess), and Supply Chess.

items.title: Reversi
items.body: Standard Reversi, Othello rules, and Anti-Reversi. Automatic flipping, pass detection, endgame scoring.

items.title: Pure ES modules
items.body: Zero dependencies. No build step required. Import what you need directly from source. 15 modular packages.

items.title: Six topologies
items.body: Grid, Hex, Track, Pit, Graph, and Tableau. Any game board shape, from standard 8x8 to hex galaxies and card tableaux.

items.title: Pluggable AI
items.body: Minimax with alpha-beta pruning. Five difficulty tiers. Family-agnostic: the same engine evaluates chess, draughts, and Go positions.

items.title: SVG renderer
items.body: Server-side and client-side rendering. Recolorable pieces. Theme-agnostic boards. Export as PNG or embed as live interactive widgets.

items.title: Embed SDK
items.body: Drop-in iframe widgets with postMessage bridging. Mount a playable board in any web page with three lines of code.

items.title: {{counts.engine_tests}}+ tests
items.body: Move generation, AI evaluation, rendering pipeline, FEN parsing, variant rules. Every family, every topology, every edge case.

items.title: Piece sets
items.body: {{counts.engine_pieces}} recolorable SVG piece sets spanning chess, draughts, shogi, xiangqi, Go, and abstract traditions.

items.title: Board layouts
items.body: Downloadable board diagrams for every supported variant. SVG and PNG export. Custom colours and grid overlays.

items.title: Hex tiles
items.body: {{counts.engine_tiles}} terrain and game tiles for hex map generation. Four styles, procedural placement, field-of-view and pathfinding.

sections.cta_heading: Fork it. Embed it. Extend it
sections.cta_body: MIT licensed. Published as importable ES modules. Used by the tools API, three original games, and seven community mods. The engine powers everything in this ecosystem.
